resources.string: Available now: %1$d MB (%2$.1f GB). Device total: %3$d MB (%4$.1f GB). Slider max: %5$d MB (%6$.1f GB). Locked mode uses available RAM; unlocked mode uses device total RAM. Tap the RAM value to enter a number manually.
Enter RAM in MB. Maximum allowed: %1$d MB.
Unlocking RAM will let you allocate up to the device-reported maximum RAM. Use this at your own risk. Setting RAM too high can make Minecraft, Android, or the whole device unstable.
Relocking RAM will return the global and per-instance RAM sliders to the current Android available RAM limit. The saved default is not reset; values above available RAM will be clamped when applied.
